{{Quote|I need you to meet with an Ithorian scientist named T'licl Zanedi. He works at an Imperial warehouse, but it ain't really a warehouse. They have some sort of scientific research going on there.|[[Qual'do Herm]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TIS" />}}
An '''Imperial warehouse''' in the [[Riverlands]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used as a secret research center by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Empire is experimenting with some sort of concentrated energy compound. It's unstable and dangerous.|[[T'licl Zanedi]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TIS" />}}
[[File:TliclZanediImperialWarehouse-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|175px|[[T'licl Zanedi]] standing near the warehouse.]]
The facility was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Although the building was officially a warehouse, it was in fact a secret military research center. The Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] working there intended to develop a new sort of concentrated energy source.<ref name="SWG:TIS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] scientist [[T'licl Zanedi]] who worked at the "warehouse" contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to reveal the aim of the Imperial project. Rebel [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Qual'do Herm]] then dispatched a group of Rebel operatives to assault the warehouse. The Rebel spacers therefore attacked the building that was defended by a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. They eventually managed to access the research facility and stole the design overview of the project, development notes and a sample of the new energy compound.<ref name="SWG:TIS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial warehouse was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TIS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial warehouse was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]]," released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
